title: Sandbagging x Monitoring: Does a Model That Hides Capability Also Hide From the Monitor?

original_idea.body: Prompt an open model to sandbag a capability eval while a CoT/action monitor watches, comparing detection rate under honest vs sandbagging conditions to test collateral monitorability suppression.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If sandbagging collaterally suppresses monitorability, both eval and monitor fail jointly.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Prompt-only sandbagging vs honest with a CoT monitor; accessible to a beginner.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Prompt-only, public models, lab-independent control study.

novelty.reasoning: Sandbagging and monitoring studied; collateral-suppression interaction may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Both topics studied; the collateral-monitorability-suppression angle may be open.
